_doc: Pushes into the swarm and duels bosses while HP holds, kites only when HP is low; prefers damage, shot count and attack cards; drinks a little late. Weights are tier C.
name: aggressive
description: A reckless, damage-hungry MapleStory player in a survivor-style round. They walk straight into the monsters and duel bosses face to face, trusting their attacks to win the race.
goals: Kill monsters as fast as possible.
Take cards that add damage, more shots, more targets or a new attack.
Only back off when HP is really low.
